description: This script is used to interpret tombstone contents by mapping addresses to source code lines using addr2line. It processes input files, matches patterns of addresses, and optionally includes source code snippets in the output. It is part of a debugging or crash analysis toolset within the Android project.

methods.name: lookup_addr
methods.description: Looks up the source code location for a given address using addr2line.

methods.name: simple_match
methods.description: Outputs a line with its source location info appended.

methods.name: source_match
methods.description: Outputs the source code line and context for a given address.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes each line of input, matching address patterns and annotating with source info.

methods.name: process_file
methods.description: Processes a single file, adding source info to its output.

methods.name: common_arg_parser
methods.description: Creates and returns an argument parser for the script.

methods.name: process_all
methods.description: Runs processing on all specified files in parallel.
